title: China's New Bullet Train Hit 453 km/h in Testing | China Travel Expert
description:
China's newest bullet train, the CR450, hit 453 km/h in testing — and it's built to carry passengers at a cruising 400 km/h, which would make it the world's fastest conventional train in service.

For context, China's current CR400 "Fuxing" trains already run scheduled services at up to 350 km/h. The CR450's 400 km/h target is about 80 km/h faster than France's TGV in commercial operation. Two prototypes were finished at the end of 2024; operational testing and the final design are expected to wrap up in 2026 — so it is NOT in passenger service yet. What you can ride today is the 350 km/h Fuxing.

🧭 Expert Tip: You don't need to wait — book a CR400 "Fuxing" for trips like Beijing–Shanghai (1,318 km in about 4.5 hours) and you're already travelling at 350 km/h.

中国最新的CR450动车组测试时速453,设计商业时速400——现在能坐的"复兴号"CR400,已经跑到350。
